listeners.doc: Webhook listener that dispatches each inbound HubSpot CRM webhook event to the concrete service type matching its object.

serviceTypes.doc: Receives HubSpot ticket events: property change, deletion, creation, merge, restore, and association change.
Receives HubSpot company events: deletion, restore, merge, property change, creation, and association change.
Receives HubSpot line item events: merge, deletion, property change, restore, association change, and creation.
Receives HubSpot product events: property change, deletion, merge, restore, and creation.
Receives HubSpot conversation events: creation, property change, privacy deletion, new message, and deletion.
Receives HubSpot deal events: deletion, creation, merge, property change, restore, and association change.
Receives HubSpot contact events: creation, association change, deletion, privacy deletion, property change, merge, and restore.
